panels.description: The station bulkhead descends while water rushes through a ruptured side passage. Keep upper bulkhead clear.
Adrian completes the recording and reaches for the dormant Bi11bot activation control. Keep upper controls clear.
The bulkhead seals across Adrian's reaching hand; crop before showing what lies beyond it. Keep upper metal clear.
In the present, Alex stands before the blank projector while B11 faces the empty station. Keep upper projector clear.
